description: Convert between Nigerian naira and US dollars, pounds, euros and other currencies at the Central Bank of Nigeria's official rate — the latest, or the rate that applied on a past date. The dollar uses the NFEM rate (the volume-weighted average CBN publishes); other currencies use CBN's selling rate. Never a parallel-market figure. Returns the converted amount with the rate, the trading date it applies to, and the CBN source. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/ng/fx

date.description: Use the rate that applied on this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, from 2024-12-02 onwards — e.g. an invoice date. On a weekend or public holiday the last trading day's rate applies. Default: the latest rate.

from.description: The currency the amount is in. Default USD.

to.description: Only when from is NGN: the currency to convert to. Default USD.

name: usd_ngn_convert
title: Convert naira at the official CBN rate
